mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates reduce the present value of future equity cash flows and increase cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction effect between UNRATE and PAYEMS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 97.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 97.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month and RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as stronger manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
